segments.text: Kalanley is cool, but what if you could self-host it for free? Meet Cloudme, a simple open-source meeting scheduler that runs entirely on Cloudflare's free
tier. Connect Google Calendar, Outlook calendar, or even both at the same time.
Cloud Meet automatically creates meetings with Google Meet or Microsoft Teams links. No copy paste required.
Customize your availability, set working hours, add different time slots like 30 minute or 1 hour sessions, and instantly
send confirmations, reminders, and cancellation emails. Completely customizable inside a clean dashboard.
